roadmap.title: Ship and Mafia Town basics
roadmap.description: On the ship, sit in three seats, ride the vacuum and buy your first badge. Do Welcome to Mafia Town away from the main path, then kick the sitting Mafia and slide down the beach slope.

roadmap.title: Battle of the Birds and Subcon Forest
roadmap.description: Pick up the badge pins and scooter, then finish the stealth, clue and parade challenges. Get the Hookshot in the Subcon Well and do the well, mushroom and hideout challenges.

roadmap.title: Alpine Skyline and chapter clears
roadmap.description: Do the Lava Cake and spider chain in Alpine Skyline, craft the Time Stop Hat, then clear Train Rush and finish every Time Piece in the four chapters.

roadmap.title: Seal the Deal and Nyakuza Metro DLC
roadmap.description: With Seal the Deal, clear the Arctic Cruise, Death Wish contracts and stamps. With Nyakuza Metro, collect the stickers, food combos and Time Pieces.

roadmap.title: Co-op, Workshop and Online Party
roadmap.description: Enable co-op on three new Time Pieces, play and rate Workshop levels, then finish the Online Party tasks.

achievements.description: Put on your first badge!
achievements.summary: Equip your first badge.

steps.text: Buy any badge from the @npc{Badge Seller}, such as the 50-Pon @item{Item Magnet Badge}, and equip it on your hat.

achievements.description: No hand-holding for you, apparently!
achievements.summary: Clear the first Mafia Town act while @npc{Mustache Girl} never spots you.

guide.context: Another route is to jump on the barrel to your right and double jump around the edge of the tarp.

steps.text: Start @loc{Welcome to Mafia Town} and stay in the starting alley. Do not take the main path or press the crane button.
Go to the back wall, double jump and wall run to grab the railing, then climb over it toward the fountain.
Walk to the Time Piece in the main plaza. If @npc{Mustache Girl} appears, restart the act.

achievements.description: Complete Train Rush without dying or time bonuses!
achievements.summary: Finish Train Rush without dying or picking up a time bonus.

guide.context: Train Rush needs the @item{Hookshot Badge} from @loc{Subcon Forest}.

steps.text: Craft the @item{Time Stop Hat} from yarn found in @loc{Alpine Skyline}, and equip the @item{Fast Hatter Badge}.
Replay @loc{Train Rush} (Chapter 2, Act 4) and avoid every time bonus.
Skip the bonus inside the flaming hoop: double jump and dive to the platform behind it instead of using the @item{Hookshot Badge}.

achievements.description: Hook onto a ceiling fan with the hookshot!
achievements.summary: Hook onto the ceiling fan in the ship's mail room with the Hookshot Badge.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Hookshot Badge} at the base of the well in @loc{Subcon Forest} (act two), and craft the @item{Ice Hat}.
In the ship's main room, use the Ice Hat ability on the slide near the Chapter 2 door to reach the mail room.
Equip the Hookshot Badge and hook onto the ceiling fan.

achievements.description: Defeat any boss with the 1-hit hero badge equipped!
achievements.summary: Beat a boss other than @enemy{Snatcher} while wearing the @item{1-Hit Hero Badge}.

guide.context: @enemy{Snatcher} takes your hat, which turns the badge off, so that fight does not count.

steps.text: Equip the @item{1-Hit Hero Badge} and fight the @enemy{Mafia Boss} or the @enemy{Toilet of Doom}, which are the easiest picks.
Stay far from the @enemy{Mafia Boss} during his spin, and watch for his shock waves and bouncing sparks. Any hit ends the try.

achievements.description: Sit in 3 different chairs!
achievements.summary: Sit in 3 different seats.

steps.text: On the ship, sit in the bedroom chair, on the pillow in front of the TV, and in the Captain's chair in the main room.

achievements.description: Do a 360 flip on the scooter!
achievements.summary: Spin the scooter 360 degrees in the air and land.

guide.context: A true flip is not possible; a full spin counts.

steps.text: Purchase the @item{Scooter Badge} for 500 Pons at the @npc{Badge Seller}, then wear it together with the @item{Sprint Hat}.
Ride off a tall ledge, for example @loc{Mafia HQ} in @loc{Mafia Town}. Hold left or right in the air to turn once all the way around, then land.

achievements.description: Make it through Dead Bird Studio without being seen at all!
achievements.summary: Finish Dead Bird Studio without any enemy seeing you.

guide.context: Wearing the @item{Time Stop Hat} and the @item{Fast Hatter Badge} together slows the guards, so you have longer to react.

steps.text: Replay the first act of Chapter 2, @loc{Dead Bird Studio}. Study how each owl and penguin patrols before you move.
Use the @item{Ice Hat} to stay unseen, and use the @item{Camera Badge} to look ahead. On the automated train near the end, the Ice Hat lets you ride past unseen.
Reach the bottom of the red carpet without being seen at all. Even a brief sighting ends the try, so restart the act if that happens.

achievements.description: Find all Murder on the Owl Express clues!
achievements.summary: Collect all 6 clues in Murder on the Owl Express.

guide.context: Take the Rec Room, Luggage Room and VIP Room clues before moving on to the heavily guarded rooms. If you fail to rescue your pet's pet, replay the act.

collectibles.name: Rec Room clue
collectibles.location: @loc{Rec Room}, on the floor
collectibles.method: Walk up and pick it up.

collectibles.name: Luggage Room clue
collectibles.location: @loc{Luggage Room}, back corner patrolled by a pair of @enemy{C.A.W. agents}
collectibles.method: Wall jump until an agent walks past, or jump to the ledge on the right path, then grab it.

collectibles.name: VIP Room clue
collectibles.location: @loc{VIP Room}, on a table circled by one @enemy{C.A.W. agent}
collectibles.method: Time your run past the agent and take it.

collectibles.name: Engine Room clue
collectibles.location: @loc{Engine Room}
collectibles.method: Climb up to the switch and rescue your pet's pet, who then gives you the clue.

collectibles.name: Lounge clue
collectibles.location: @loc{Lounge}, on a cart (two right turns in), with two agents patrolling
collectibles.method: Avoid the agents and take it.

collectibles.name: KEEP OUT room clue
collectibles.location: Room painted "KEEP OUT" above the room full of crows watching the monitor
collectibles.method: Press the switch you reach after leaving the Lounge to open the door. Grab this clue last, since exiting that room ends the act.

achievements.description: Make it through Murder on the Owl Express without finding any clues (you suck)!
achievements.summary: Clear Murder on the Owl Express while picking up zero clues.

guide.context: Skipped clues cost 600 points toward Fueling the Feud, so do this run first and replay for the clues later.

steps.text: Run the second act of Chapter 2 normally (@loc{Murder on the Owl Express}), walking through the rooms but leaving every clue where it is.
At the end, pick the @npc{Conductor} as the culprit.

achievements.description: Ride the vacuum!
achievements.summary: Ride the vacuum on the ship.

steps.text: Hit the vacuum @npc{Rumbi} in the ship's main room to stun it, or pin it against a wall, then jump on top and stay on for a few seconds.

achievements.description: Don't fall into the rising water in Subcon Well!
achievements.summary: Climb out of Subcon Well without touching the rising water.

guide.context: The small puddle at the start is safe to touch before the water begins rising.

steps.text: In the well act of @loc{Subcon Forest}, pull the lever, then dive straight into the pipe so the water cannot catch you.
Climb to the top without touching the water. The water stops rising while you wait. If you fall in, restart the act.

achievements.description: Slide down a really long slope!
achievements.summary: Slide more than 20 metres along the ground in one go.

guide.context: Only horizontal distance counts, so a steep drop does not help.

steps.text: In @loc{Mafia Town}, enter the big yellow slide near the beach and avoid the sign at its end.

achievements.description: Complete the Lava Cake peak without touching the lava at all!
achievements.summary: Reach the top of the Lava Cake without touching lava.

guide.context: Fire damage from other sources is allowed.

steps.text: Climb the pillars of @loc{The Lava Cake} in @loc{Alpine Skyline} and take the Time Piece at the top without touching the lava.

achievements.description: Complete The Big Parade without falling into the audience below!
achievements.summary: Finish The Big Parade without falling onto the penguin crowd.

steps.text: Replay the fifth act of Chapter 2 (@loc{The Big Parade}). Hop across the roofs and stay out of the crowd on the ground.
If hazards threaten, take their damage rather than risk falling.

achievements.description: Climb to the top of Subcon Forest's big mushroom!
achievements.summary: Climb to the big mushroom at the top of the tree in Subcon Forest.

guide.context: Equip the Umbrella Badge to soften falls. A fall to the bottom lands in water and does no damage.

steps.text: In @loc{Subcon Forest} Act 1, turn around at the start and climb the tree to the giant blue mushroom.

achievements.description: Find Your Secret Hideout!
achievements.summary: Enter Hat Kid's secret hideout on the ship.

steps.text: Collect @item{Ice Yarn}, for example in the @loc{Dead Bird Studio} act, and craft the @item{Ice Hat}.
Open the bedroom, which needs 7 Time Pieces.
In the bedroom, use the Ice Hat ability on the pillar of light above the pillow pile.

achievements.description: Equip 3 badges!
achievements.summary: Equip 3 badges at once.

steps.text: Buy both Badge Pins from the @npc{Badge Seller}. If no pin is offered yet, keep buying badges until one appears.
Equip three badges.

achievements.description: Knock off all the sitting Mafia in Mafia Town!
achievements.summary: Kick all 5 sitting Mafia off their perches in Mafia Town in one run.

guide.context: All five are reachable without badges or hats. They return when the act ends, so get all five before finishing the act. Act 7 is a good one to use.

achievements.description: Do 5 homing attacks in a row, without touching the ground!
achievements.summary: Defeat 5 enemies in a row with homing attacks without touching the ground.

guide.context: In Mafia Town, a blue vault ticket draws crows that also work.

steps.text: In @loc{Alpine Skyline}, take the path toward the Lava Cake where spiders drop down. At the fork, homing attack one group of three spiders, then keep going on the other group.
If you land, start again.

achievements.description: Collect all Time Pieces!
achievements.summary: Own all Time Pieces that exist in your installed game content.

guide.context: If it does not unlock with DLC installed, turn off all DLC in the game's Steam properties and collect any base Time Piece again.

steps.text: Clear the four main chapters with the checklists in this guide. Then take the two ship rifts: one in the mail room (reach it with the Ice Hat) and one in the Chapter 2 hub (go left, pass the green door marked with a brush, and stand mid-room).
Finish Chapter 5 (Time's End) for the final base Time Piece.
Seal the Deal adds 6 more (5 on the cruise and 1 on the ship), and Nyakuza Metro adds 10. The game wants 40 pieces for the base game, 46 with Seal the Deal, 50 with Nyakuza Metro, or 56 with both.

achievements.description: Get a total of 2000 points in Battle of the Birds!
achievements.summary: Reach 2000 total points in Acts 2 to 5 of Battle of the Birds.

steps.text: Earn points in acts two to five of Chapter 2 (the train murder, Picture Perfect, Train Rush and the parade). A director icon is worth 100, a Pon 4, a clue 60, and each second left in Train Rush 3.
Take every clue and director icon in Murder on the Owl Express and farm Pons in Picture Perfect. Train Rush needs the @item{Hookshot Badge} from the Subcon well.
Replay any act before Act 6 to raise the total.

achievements.description: Light up the spaceship!
achievements.summary: Collect your first Time Piece to light up the spaceship.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Welcome to Mafia Town} and collect the Time Piece.

achievements.description: just... why... ?
achievements.summary: Type a swear word into an answer box.

guide.context: Battle of the Birds opens at 4 Time Pieces.

steps.text: In @loc{Murder on the Owl Express}, answer the crow agent in the cafeteria who asks which body part you are ashamed of with a swear word. The Chapter 2 supercomputer also takes input.
"peck", "peckneck" and "timmy" also work.

achievements.description: Play a mod from the Steam Workshop!
achievements.summary: Play a Steam Workshop mod.

steps.text: Subscribe to any mod in the Steam Workshop, then launch the game with it installed.

achievements.description: Rate a Steam Workshop level!
achievements.summary: Rate a Steam Workshop level.

steps.text: Subscribe to a level, then talk to the @npc{Mafia goon} in the ship's mail room to play it.
Finish the level and press thumbs up or thumbs down on the rating screen.

achievements.description: Collect 30 Mod Rift Tokens from Steam Workshop levels!
achievements.summary: Collect 30 Rift Tokens from Steam Workshop levels.

steps.text: Talk to the @npc{Mafia goon} in the ship's mail room and play Workshop levels. Collect each level's Time Piece, which gives one Mod Rift Token. Tokens found inside a level do not count.
Check your count on the save file screen.

achievements.description: Clear All Objectives In a Single Death Wish!
achievements.summary: Complete the main goal and both bonus goals of one Death Wish contract.

guide.context: Needs the Seal the Deal DLC.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Your Contract has Expired} and collect 27 Time Pieces to unlock Death Wish, then talk to @npc{Snatcher}.
Pick one contract and clear its main goal first, then each bonus goal. You can do them on separate tries.
Do not turn on Peace and Tranquility or Assist Mode, which disables the bonus goals.

achievements.description: Obtain 50 Death Wish Stamps!
achievements.summary: Earn 50 Death Wish stamps.

guide.context: Needs the Seal the Deal DLC. Each contract is worth 3 stamps.

steps.text: Clear the main goal and both bonus goals of contracts for 3 stamps each, until you have 50.
Keep Peace and Tranquility off so every bonus counts as normal.

achievements.description: Obtain All Death Wish Stamps!
achievements.summary: Earn every Death Wish stamp.

guide.context: Needs the Seal the Deal DLC.

steps.text: Clear the main goal and both bonus goals of every contract on the Death Wish map, including the Community Rift stamps, for 111 stamps (114 with Nyakuza Metro installed).
Keep Peace and Tranquility off.

achievements.description: Clear Ship Shape Without Upsetting The Captain!
achievements.summary: Finish Ship Shape without letting the Captain's anger go past blue.

guide.context: Needs the Seal the Deal DLC.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Ship Shape}, the second act of @loc{The Arctic Cruise}.
Equip the @item{Sprint Hat} for speed. Or wear the @item{Time Stop Hat} and add the @item{Fast Hatter Badge}, which slows the anger meter.
Keep the Captain's anger meter below 3 notches until every task is done. Start all available tasks so the meter pauses.
Use the Ice Hat pad on the ship's edge to reach the pool quickly.

achievements.description: Collect all Time Pieces in The Arctic Cruise!
achievements.summary: Collect every Time Piece in The Arctic Cruise.

guide.context: Needs the Seal the Deal DLC. The Arctic Cruise opens at 35 Time Pieces.

steps.text: Plug in a second controller and turn co-op on before touching a Time Piece you have not collected yet. Repeat for three pieces.

achievements.description: Put 10 different stickers on a single screenshot!

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC.

steps.text: Collect at least 10 different stickers (you start with 3). Get the @item{Camera Badge} from the island with the Tourist in @loc{Mafia Town}.
Open the camera, place 10 different stickers on the frame, and take the picture.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC. 46 stickers lie around the Metro, and 6 more come from food combos. Collect all of the Metro ones to be safe. A sticker on a wall drops to the floor when touched, so pick it up there.

achievements.summary: Collect your first holographic sticker.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC. Only one spawns per day, and it can appear in any level.

steps.text: Clear any level. If a holographic sticker spawns, the game names its act, and the console in the ship also shows it.
Equip the @item{Compass Badge} (400 Pons from the Mafia Boss). Its rainbow arrow points toward the sticker with some error.
Find and touch the sticker.

achievements.description: Discover a secret food combination!
achievements.summary: Eat a secret food combination.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC. Large Soda also pairs with Hamburger, Pizza Slice or Triple Scoop, but the five pairs named in the step are the safest picks.

steps.text: In a @loc{Nyakuza Metro} restaurant, buy both foods of a pair and eat them together, such as Cake with Juice Box, Coffee with Cookies, Fish with French Fries, Katsu Curry with Rice, or Soup Dumplings with Tea.

achievements.description: Collect all Time Pieces in Nyakuza Metro!
achievements.summary: Collect every Time Piece in Nyakuza Metro.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC. It opens at 20 Time Pieces through the Storage Room (Science Lab, basement). If it does not unlock, recollect an already collected piece here.

achievements.description: Clear an act in Online Party as the person in lead!
achievements.summary: Finish an Online Party act in first place.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC. The score is added up when the Time Piece is taken.

steps.text: Turn on Online Party and join a lobby with another player. Start an act that player joins.
Collect the Time Piece first. It gives 80, 50 or 20 points for 1st, 2nd or 3rd. Blue rift acts are fast.

achievements.description: Participate in an Online Party with 10 or more total players!
achievements.summary: Join an Online Party lobby of at least 10 players.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC.

steps.text: Turn on Online Party and join a busy lobby name, such as "peck". Events fill lobbies faster.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Time Pieces in an active Online Party!
achievements.summary: Get 10 Time Pieces while Online Party is on.

guide.context: Needs the Nyakuza Metro DLC.

steps.text: Turn on Online Party and finish acts. Repeating the same act counts, and Welcome to Mafia Town is fast.
If it does not count, join levels that have other players in them.

achievements.description: Clear a Challenge Road!
achievements.summary: Clear a Challenge Road.

steps.text: Talk to the @npc{Mafia goon} in the ship's mail room and download the Workshop levels for a Challenge Road.
Finish its 2 to 7 levels in order. You have 3 lives in total, and losing all of them sends you back to the start.
